One of the coolest pieces of gear at The Boring Company is “The Monster” — designed and built in Bastrop.
This 140,000 lb transporter carries 465–480k lb Prufrock sections and tilts ±10° so the machine can launch straight into the ground.
No pit. No shaft. No concrete. No crane.
That means they can retrieve and relaunch Prufrock inside buildings (like the Tesla Gigafactory) and move it to the next site with SPMTs in under 24 hours.
Urban tunneling just got a lot more practical. 🚀

FULL WALKAROUND: Tesla Model YL Launch Series 

The 6-Seater Family Hauler We’ve Been Waiting For!Just got hands-on with the brand-new Tesla Model Y L Launch Series and it’s a game-changer. 

Longer wheelbase, proper third row, captain’s chairs, and serious range – this is Tesla finally giving families a real three-row EV without the Model X price tag.

Key Specs You Need to Know (triple-checked): 

6 seats in a true 2+2+2 layout (captain’s chairs in the second row)
325 miles EPA estimated range (19" wheels) / ~320 miles with 20s
0-60 mph in 4.4 seconds (Dual Motor AWD)
89 cubic feet of total cargo space
~7 inches longer overall + ~6-inch longer wheelbase for real third-row legroom & headroom
Peak Supercharging ~250 kW – add up to 164 miles in 15 minutes
Launch Series exclusive perks: 1 year of Full Self-Driving (Supervised), 1 year of Supercharging, 1 year of Premium Connectivity, free paint/interior/wheels choice, special badging, premium mats, and more

In this full walkaround I cover exterior design, the stretched proportions, interior space (especially that usable third row), the premium materials, screens, audio, seating comfort, cargo flexibility, and all the little Launch Series details that make it special. 

Is this the Model X replacement for most families? After walking every inch… yeah, IT IS. 

Drop a like if you’re ordering one or already have it on the way!

Grok Build v0.2.120 is now available.

SpaceXAI continues to roll out Grok Build updates at a rapid pace.

What's fixed in v0.2.120:
• The model picker now updates the status bar and /model menu immediately, even before the first prompt starts a session.
• The Changes panel now refreshes correctly after an agent commits to the current branch.
• Background task completions now include the full log size and a read hint, even when only a short log preview is available.
• GitHub export for older hibernated sessions now shows a clear prompt to start a new chat instead of a generic error.

Get Grok Build: x.ai/cli

Update commands:
• Alpha: grok update --alpha
• Stable: grok update

SpaceXAI is steadily refining Grok Build with frequent improvements and bug fixes.

BREAKING: Tesla registrations surged across key European markets in July. 🇪🇺⚡

• Tesla registrations jumped 86% year over year in France, marking its second-best July on record.
• In Denmark, Tesla registrations increased 52% compared with July 2025.
• According to European auto market analyst Matthias Schmidt, Tesla appears to be prioritizing incentive-rich markets such as France and Germany, where volumes could rise sharply in the second half of 2026.
• Schmidt added that comparatively weaker sales in Sweden, Norway, and Spain may reflect that strategy.

Tesla's European market strategy appears to be shifting toward regions with the strongest demand incentives.

Model Y L Canyon Drive: Six-Seat Family SUV That Hugs Corners Like a Sports Car + FSD 14.3.7 from Topanga Beach to Santa Monica

This one felt different the second we left the pavement.

I took the brand-new Tesla Model Y L through the canyons of Woodland Hills and it completely rewired what I thought a six-seater family SUV could do. This is not a stretched Model Y that just gained a third row and lost its soul. 

The weight is planted, the balance is dialed, and it leans into turns with a confidence that feels closer to a two-door sports car than a three-row people mover.

We spent real time comparing the adaptive suspension modes. In Balanced it stays composed and connected. Flip it to Rear Comfort and the character shifts — the rear settles into a softer, more isolated ride while the front gets a touch more movement. Joe (the Prez) sat up front with me first, then moved to the second row and immediately felt the difference. For families, this is the feature that actually matters. 

You can keep the driver engaged while the people you care about in the back get the smoother ride. Absolute game-changer.

Then we handed the wheel to Full Self-Driving (Supervised) v14.3.7 and ran it from Topanga Beach all the way to Santa Monica. Smooth, confident, and still the clearest proof that Tesla’s software is in a different league. 

No other six-seat EV combines this level of performance, efficiency, and autonomy in one package.

Key numbers that make the Model Y L special:
•  True 2+2+2 six-seat layout with second-row captain’s chairs
•  Second and third rows fold completely flat
•  0-60 mph in 4.4 seconds — quicker than the Model Y Premium AWD
•  Class-leading 0.216 coefficient of drag for efficiency
•  Adaptive continuous damping with Balanced and Rear Comfort modes
•  Longer wheelbase that finally delivers usable third-row space without killing the driving dynamics

This is the family SUV that doesn’t force you to choose between space, comfort, and the way it drives. It feels unlike anything else I’ve driven in this segment.
